notes: וְאֵין לָהֶן is read under rule 43: אֵין keeps the negation and heads on *not* (rule 50), the possessive לְ takes *had*, and the suffix takes the subject pronoun *they*.
The italic *the uppermost* has no source nominal answering to it and is `added` under rule 17's limit; the ASV italics corroborate it (rule 7).
Two comparative מִן tokens against one written *more than*: the first takes it and the second is unrepresented (rule 22), while the third מִן keeps its own *from*.
